groups.label: Proximal / stable ankle-equivalent
groups.description: Fibular injury patterns with attention to syndesmotic and ankle stability.

variants.label: Isolated fibular avulsion
variants.description: Small avulsion fragment or nondisplaced proximal fibular injury.

variants.label: Proximal fibular fracture
variants.description: Proximal fibular fracture requiring assessment for syndesmotic or Maisonneuve pattern.

variants.label: Associated ligament injury
variants.description: Proximal fibula injury with suspected ankle instability.

treatments.label: Ankle stability assessment
treatments.main_indications: Rule out syndesmotic instability or medial ankle injury.

treatments.label: Nonoperative care
treatments.main_indications: Stable isolated injury without syndesmotic or medial instability.

treatments.label: Syndesmosis fixation principles
treatments.main_indications: Proximal fibula fracture with unstable syndesmotic injury.

groups.label: Trans-syndesmotic / shaft
groups.description: Fibular shaft or trans-syndesmotic fracture patterns where ankle mortise stability guides treatment.

variants.label: Simple shaft
variants.description: Simple fibular shaft fracture without mortise widening.

variants.label: Shaft with medial injury
variants.description: Fibular fracture with deltoid or medial malleolar injury.

variants.label: Shaft with posterior injury
variants.description: Fibular fracture with posterior malleolar or posterior syndesmotic involvement.

treatments.label: Fibular plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Unstable ankle mortise, displacement, or need to restore fibular length and rotation.

treatments.label: Cast / boot treatment
treatments.main_indications: Stable isolated fracture with congruent mortise.

treatments.label: Intraoperative imaging
treatments.main_indications: Confirming mortise reduction, fibular length, and implant position.

groups.label: Supra-syndesmotic / malleolar
groups.description: Distal fibular and lateral malleolar fractures with syndesmotic instability risk.

variants.label: High fibula / Maisonneuve pattern
variants.description: High fibular injury associated with syndesmotic disruption.

treatments.label: ORIF with syndesmosis stabilization
treatments.main_indications: Unstable lateral malleolus or supra-syndesmotic pattern with mortise instability.

treatments.label: Temporary external fixation
treatments.main_indications: Severe swelling, fracture-dislocation, open injury, or staged ankle reconstruction.

treatments.label: Mortise imaging reference
treatments.main_indications: Assessment of syndesmotic reduction and ankle mortise congruity.
